elephant.line: But you can't paint an elephant
stanza: This has got to lie down
But you can't paint an elephant

elephant.songTitle: If I Were King of the Forest (Extended Version)

elephant.line: On the back of an elephant
stanza: Here she comes in her palanquin
On the back of an elephant
On a bed made of linen and sequins and silk
All astride on her father's line
With the king and his concubines
And her nurse with her pitchers of liquors and milk
And we'll all come praise the infanta
And we'll all come praise the infanta
